items.question: Would you rather go shopping or go to the movies tonight?
items.answer_explain: 原文依据：问句或陈述是“Would you rather go shopping or go to the movies tonight?”，自然应答是“I have to work until eight.”。选择理由：该项在语义和会话功能上直接承接前句；其余选项只是词汇相关、时态不合或答非所问。正确答案：B（I have to work until eight.）。
